text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the last day of the training camp...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How was that, Trainer? That was super
fast, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
choice_data_list: That kind of speed in a sandbox is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I leveled up during the
training camp!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I was fast before, but now I'm even
faster! My
speed is more Bakushin than
ever!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Sprinters Stakes is all
mine! It's as
good as in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If I don't win by a huge lead, I'll change
my name
to "Sakura O"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Anything other than a victory
is
unthinkable after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Please enjoy watching from the sidelines!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so Sakura Bakushin O's passionate
(?)
summer camp adventures come to an
end.
